resources.name: Density functional parameters from Pricaupenko & Treiner (1994)

access.notes: Contains parameters c, γ, d1, d2, effective mass form, and Lennard-Jones interaction parameters for the density functional.
Parameters A=226.7 K, α=3.175 Å⁻¹, C3=1830.9 K Å³, C4=10305.9 K Å⁴ are fixed constants hard-coded in the task instructions.
Required for numerical computation and solving the Hartree-Fock equations.
